svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-semiformal-class-a-coat-male-cord-aide-de-camp","name":"Men's cadet semi-formal coat: USAF aide de camp aiguillette cord (silver, single loop, chrome tip) (overlay, registered to garment-semiformal-class-a-coat-male)","size_in":{"w":25.7745,"h":32.5595},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2577.45,3255.95],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Same box as garment-semiformal-class-a-coat-male; 0.36 in braid following the wearer's left armhole seam; colours from assets/cords/cord-aide-de-camp.spec.json. The regulation gives no cord dimension. Aiguillette parts (loop, whipping, thin cord, pencil tip) are drawn as the overlay's own groups: proportions in braid thicknesses B (0.36 in here) from Vanguard SKU 3710210 (assets/cords/ref/README.md): free loop 5.9 x 4.7 B outer = 2.1 x 1.7 in, an oval with its inner edge on the run, whipping 0.9 x 2.6 B, thin cord 3.9 B long and 0.14 B thick, pencil tip 1.2 in (4.1 B at the 0.30 in braid of cord-aide-de-camp), so the tip point hangs about 4.0 in below the contact point.
